hypothesis_tested: Coupling: uptake without export is counterproductive
falsifying_observation: Boosting efferocytosis alone shrinks the necrotic core as well as co-delivery does
cheapest_experiment: Apoe-null or Ldlr-null mice, four arms: anti-CD47 alone, macrophage-targeted LXR agonist alone, both, control; 12 weeks on Western diet
readout: Necrotic core area and free/macrophage-associated TUNEL ratio on aortic root sections; the design is only worth building if the combination beats both single arms on core area

hypothesis_tested: Fuel: dissolved crystal cholesterol really does drive the loop
falsifying_observation: Crystal solubilisation adds no oxysterol signal or no ABCA1/MerTK induction in human plaque macrophages
cheapest_experiment: Ex vivo human carotid endarterectomy explants, cyclodextrin versus vehicle, 48 hours
readout: Oxysterol mass spectrometry plus ABCA1/ABCG1/MerTK expression; no induction means the self-fuelling claim is dead

hypothesis_tested: Gate: lesion-restricted release is achievable at a useful dose
falsifying_observation: Dual-recognition particles cannot exceed ~25% lesional delivery, or systemic exposure still causes anaemia or hepatic steatosis
cheapest_experiment: Biodistribution and toxicology in a large animal with labelled particles; haemoglobin, reticulocytes, liver triglyceride
readout: Lesion-to-liver ratio and dose-limiting toxicity; without the gate the efficacious dose is unreachable

hypothesis_tested: Mineral: suppressing nucleation does not destabilise the cap
falsifying_observation: Blocking microcalcification nucleation thins the cap or raises rupture features instead of shifting mineral to stable macro
cheapest_experiment: Same animals, OCT/NaF-PET plus histology for cap thickness and micro-deposit size distribution
readout: Cap thickness and micro versus macro mineral fraction; a thinner cap kills module M6 outright

hypothesis_tested: Durability: tolerance prevents recurrence after withdrawal
falsifying_observation: Lesions regrow at control rates once the chassis is withdrawn despite CAR-Treg transfer
cheapest_experiment: Withdrawal-and-rechallenge design in the mouse regression model
readout: Substrate burden 12 weeks after withdrawal; recurrence means this is a chronic therapy, not a cure
